correctness.rationale: There is a direct W-equivariant augmented chain isomorphism via canonical rational trivial-plus-augmentation color modules. Fourteen exact finite mod-two comparisons, 1332 fiber traces and 864 full W chain-character tests independently corroborate the identities without replacing the proof.
